context.name: Meadow pine
context.notes: Demo field note: open area; no nearby occupied target reported. The wind response is simulated at a higher frequency.

brief.summary: The recording supports a motion evidence brief. Add it to routine arborist review with the field context below.
evidence: 216 frames sampled over 17.9 seconds; 100% mean tracking retention.
Camera-corrected projected displacement: 12.0 px peak to peak at 640 × 400 analysis resolution.
Dominant observed response: 0.78 Hz (frequency resolution ≈ 0.06 Hz). This is not necessarily the tree’s natural frequency.
Stationary-reference motion: 0.82 px RMS before correction.
Field context: no target reported; visible concern not reported.
nextSteps: Have a qualified arborist review the recording, field notes, target occupancy, and visible defects.
Inspect the root collar, trunk, and branch attachments on site; record observations separately.
Repeat from the same view under comparable wind conditions to build a useful time series.
limitations: Synthetic demonstration clip. It validates the software path, not real-world tree assessment.
Projected pixels are not physical displacement without scale and camera calibration.
One video cannot measure hidden decay, anchorage, probability of failure, or a safe wind threshold.
Motion magnitude and frequency alone do not rank structural safety. No failure probability or certified tree-risk rating is produced.
